items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Displays a button or a link styled as a button.
items.whenToUse: Any clickable action. Use tag: :a for a link that looks like a button, size: :icon for icon-only. For a set of related actions use button-group; for a menu of actions use dropdown-menu.
usage: <%= ui_button(variant: :outline, size: :sm) { "Save" } %>
<%= ui_button(size: :icon, "aria-label": "Add") { ui_icon("plus") } %>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small inline label for status, counts, or categories.
items.whenToUse: Non-interactive status or metadata next to content. For a clickable pill use button with size: :sm; for a keyboard key use kbd.
usage: <%= ui_badge(variant: :secondary) { "Beta" } %>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A container for grouping related content with header, body, and footer slots.
items.whenToUse: Grouping related content into a bordered surface. For a compact list row use item; for a placeholder state use empty.
usage:
<%= ui_card do %>
  <%= ui_card_header do %>
    <%= ui_card_title { "Team" } %>
    <%= ui_card_description { "Manage members." } %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_card_content { "Body" } %>
  <%= ui_card_footer { ui_button { "Save" } } %>
<% end %>

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout for important inline messages.
items.whenToUse: Persistent inline messages inside the page. For a message that interrupts the user use alert-dialog; for transient feedback use sonner.
usage: <%= ui_alert(variant: :destructive) { "Your session expired." } %>

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule that visually divides content.
items.whenToUse: Dividing sections or menu groups. Inside a menu prefer that menu's own separator (ui_dropdown_menu_separator, ui_context_menu_separator).
usage: <%= ui_separator %>

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user or entity image with a text fallback.
items.whenToUse: Representing a person or account. Always supply fallback for when the image fails to load.
usage: <%= ui_avatar(src: user.avatar_url, alt: user.name, fallback: "JD") %>

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked sections that expand and collapse.
items.whenToUse: Several collapsible sections, typically FAQs. For a single collapsible region use collapsible; for switching between peer views use tabs.
usage:
<%= ui_accordion(multiple: false) do %>
  <%= ui_accordion_item(value: "one") do %>
    <%= ui_accordion_trigger { "Is it accessible?" } %>
    <%= ui_accordion_content { "Yes." } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable region with styled scrollbars.
items.whenToUse: Constraining a long list or panel to a fixed height with consistent scrollbars across browsers.
usage: <%= ui_scroll_area(class: "h-72 w-48 rounded-md border") { "Long content" } %>

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: A Lucide icon with shadcn-style size variants.
items.whenToUse: Any icon. Names are Lucide kebab-case. Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass label: when the icon carries meaning on its own.
usage: <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", size: :sm) %>
<%= ui_icon("trash-2", label: "Delete") %>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field.
items.whenToUse: Free-text entry. For multi-line use textarea; with an addon or button attached use input-group; wrap in field for a label and error.
usage: <%= ui_input(type: :email, name: "email", placeholder: "you@example.com") %>

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible caption bound to a form control.
items.whenToUse: Labelling a standalone control. Inside a field block prefer ui_field_label, which wires the description and error for you.
usage: <%= ui_label(for: "email") { "Email" } %>

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field.
items.whenToUse: Free-text entry spanning several lines. For one line use input.
usage: <%= ui_textarea(name: "bio", rows: 4, placeholder: "About you") %>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A binary control for opting in or selecting many items.
items.whenToUse: Independent on/off choices, or multi-select in a list. For a single setting that applies immediately use switch; for one-of-many use radio-group.
usage: <%= ui_checkbox(name: "terms", value: "1") %>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually exclusive options.
items.whenToUse: Picking exactly one of a few visible options. For many options use select; for a compact toolbar-style choice use toggle-group.
usage:
<%= ui_radio_group(name: "plan", value: "pro") do %>
  <%= ui_radio_group_item(value: "free") %>
  <%= ui_radio_group_item(value: "pro") %>
<% end %>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.
items.whenToUse: On/off settings, especially ones that apply instantly. For a value submitted with a form use checkbox.
usage: <%= ui_switch(name: "notifications", checked: true) %>

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder block shown while content loads.
items.whenToUse: Preserving layout during loading. For an indeterminate inline busy indicator use spinner; for measurable progress use progress.
usage: <%= ui_skeleton(class: "h-4 w-[250px]") %>

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar showing completion toward a known total.
items.whenToUse: Progress you can measure. When the duration is unknown use spinner; when you are waiting on content use skeleton.
usage: <%= ui_progress(value: 60) %>

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A styled HTML table with header, body, and footer sections.
items.whenToUse: Presenting rows of data you render yourself. For built-in sorting, filtering, pagination and row selection use data-table.
usage:
<%= ui_table do %>
  <%= ui_table_header do %>
    <%= ui_table_row { ui_table_head { "Name" } } %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_table_body do %>
    <%= ui_table_row { ui_table_cell { "Ada" } } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail showing the current page's position in the hierarchy.
items.whenToUse: Showing where the user is in a nested structure. For moving between top-level sections use navigation-menu.
usage:
<%= ui_breadcrumb do %>
  <%= ui_breadcrumb_list do %>
    <%= ui_breadcrumb_item { ui_breadcrumb_link(href: "/") { "Home" } } %>
    <%= ui_breadcrumb_separator %>
    <%= ui_breadcrumb_item { ui_breadcrumb_page { "Settings" } } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Navigation controls for moving between pages of results.
items.whenToUse: Paging through server-rendered result sets. The data-table component brings its own pagination.
usage:
<%= ui_pagination do %>
  <%= ui_pagination_content do %>
    <%= ui_pagination_item { ui_pagination_previous(href: "?page=1") } %>
    <%= ui_pagination_item { ui_pagination_link(href: "?page=2") { "2" } } %>
    <%= ui_pagination_item { ui_pagination_next(href: "?page=3") } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between peer views in the same space.
items.whenToUse: Alternate views of comparable content. Triggers must live inside ui_tabs_list. For expanding sections that can be open at once use accordion.
usage:
<%= ui_tabs(default_value: "account") do %>
  <%= ui_tabs_list do %>
    <%= ui_tabs_trigger(value: "account") { "Account" } %>
    <%= ui_tabs_trigger(value: "password") { "Password" } %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_tabs_content(value: "account") { "Account settings" } %>
<% end %>

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window overlaying the page.
items.whenToUse: Focused tasks that interrupt the current flow. For a destructive confirmation use alert-dialog; for a side panel use sheet; for a bottom sheet use drawer. Always include ui_dialog_title, visually hidden if needed.
usage:
<%= ui_dialog do %>
  <%= ui_dialog_trigger { ui_button { "Open" } } %>
  <%= ui_dialog_content do %>
    <%= ui_dialog_header do %>
      <%= ui_dialog_title { "Edit profile" } %>
      <%= ui_dialog_description { "Update your details." } %>
    <% end %>
    <%= ui_dialog_footer { ui_button { "Save" } } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts the user to confirm a consequential action.
items.whenToUse: Confirming destructive or irreversible actions — it cannot be dismissed by clicking outside. For ordinary modal content use dialog.
usage:
<%= ui_alert_dialog do %>
  <%= ui_alert_dialog_trigger { ui_button(variant: :destructive) { "Delete" } } %>
  <%= ui_alert_dialog_content do %>
    <%= ui_alert_dialog_header do %>
      <%= ui_alert_dialog_title { "Are you sure?" } %>
      <%= ui_alert_dialog_description { "This cannot be undone." } %>
    <% end %>
    <%= ui_alert_dialog_footer do %>
      <%= ui_alert_dialog_cancel { "Cancel" } %>
      <%= ui_alert_dialog_action { "Delete" } %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen.
items.whenToUse: Secondary content or forms alongside the page, anchored to an edge. For a centred modal use dialog; for app navigation use sidebar.
usage:
<%= ui_sheet do %>
  <%= ui_sheet_trigger { ui_button(variant: :outline) { "Open" } } %>
  <%= ui_sheet_content(side: :right) do %>
    <%= ui_sheet_header { ui_sheet_title { "Filters" } } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint shown on hover or focus.
items.whenToUse: Naming an icon-only control or adding a brief hint. Never put interactive content inside — use popover or hover-card for that.
usage:
<%= ui_tooltip do %>
  <%= ui_tooltip_trigger { ui_button(size: :icon) { ui_icon("info") } } %>
  <%= ui_tooltip_content { "More information" } %>
<% end %>

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger.
items.whenToUse: Rich or interactive content anchored to a control, opened by click. For a plain hint use tooltip; for a list of actions use dropdown-menu.
usage:
<%= ui_popover do %>
  <%= ui_popover_trigger { ui_button(variant: :outline) { "Open" } } %>
  <%= ui_popover_content { "Panel content" } %>
<% end %>

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions or options triggered by a button.
items.whenToUse: Row actions, overflow menus, and account menus. For right-click use context-menu; for an application menu bar use menubar; for choosing a form value use select.
usage:
<%= ui_dropdown_menu do %>
  <%= ui_dropdown_menu_trigger { ui_button(variant: :outline) { "Open" } } %>
  <%= ui_dropdown_menu_content do %>
    <%= ui_dropdown_menu_label { "My account" } %>
    <%= ui_dropdown_menu_separator %>
    <%= ui_dropdown_menu_item { "Profile" } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A styled control for choosing one option from a list.
items.whenToUse: Choosing a single form value from many options. For a searchable list use combobox; for the plain browser control use native-select; for a few visible options use radio-group.
usage:
<%= ui_select(name: "role", placeholder: "Select a role") do %>
  <%= ui_select_trigger { ui_select_value } %>
  <%= ui_select_content do %>
    <%= ui_select_item(value: "admin") { "Admin" } %>
    <%= ui_select_item(value: "member") { "Member" } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A composable, collapsible application sidebar.
items.whenToUse: Primary application navigation. Wrap the app in ui_sidebar_provider and put page content in ui_sidebar_inset. For a temporary edge panel use sheet.
usage:
<%= ui_sidebar_provider do %>
  <%= ui_sidebar do %>
    <%= ui_sidebar_content do %>
      <%= ui_sidebar_group do %>
        <%= ui_sidebar_menu { ui_sidebar_menu_item { ui_sidebar_menu_button { "Home" } } } %>
      <% end %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_sidebar_inset { ui_sidebar_trigger } %>
<% end %>

items.name: sidebar-01
items.title: Sidebar 01
items.description: A documentation-style dashboard layout with a collapsible sidebar, version switcher, and search.
items.whenToUse: Scaffolding a full dashboard page rather than assembling the sidebar yourself. Install the sidebar component instead when you want to compose your own layout.
usage: <%= render Ui::Blocks::Sidebar01::PageComponent.new %>

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Constrains its content to a fixed width-to-height ratio.
items.whenToUse: Keeping images, video, or embeds at a consistent shape while they scale.
usage: <%= ui_aspect_ratio(ratio: 16.0 / 9) { image_tag("cover.jpg", class: "size-full object-cover") } %>

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator.
items.whenToUse: Waits of unknown length, including inside a button. For measurable progress use progress; for content placeholders use skeleton.
usage: <%= ui_button(disabled: true) { ui_spinner + " Saving" } %>

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut.
items.whenToUse: Documenting keyboard shortcuts. Inside a menu row prefer that menu's shortcut helper, such as ui_dropdown_menu_shortcut.
usage: <%= ui_kbd_group { ui_kbd { "⌘" } + ui_kbd { "K" } } %>

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A placeholder for when there is nothing to show.
items.whenToUse: Empty lists, no search results, or first-run states. For loading use skeleton.
usage:
<%= ui_empty do %>
  <%= ui_empty_header do %>
    <%= ui_empty_media { ui_icon("inbox") } %>
    <%= ui_empty_title { "No messages" } %>
    <%= ui_empty_description { "You are all caught up." } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A compact row with media, text, and trailing actions.
items.whenToUse: List rows such as settings, files, or people. For a larger bordered surface use card.
usage:
<%= ui_item do %>
  <%= ui_item_media { ui_icon("file") } %>
  <%= ui_item_content do %>
    <%= ui_item_title { "Report.pdf" } %>
    <%= ui_item_description { "2.4 MB" } %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_item_actions { ui_button(variant: :ghost, size: :icon) { ui_icon("download") } } %>
<% end %>

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with attached addons, text, or buttons.
items.whenToUse: Prefixes, suffixes, or buttons attached to a field. Use ui_input_group_input or ui_input_group_textarea inside, never a bare input.
usage:
<%= ui_input_group do %>
  <%= ui_input_group_addon { ui_icon("search") } %>
  <%= ui_input_group_input(name: "q", placeholder: "Search") %>
<% end %>

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Related buttons joined into a single control.
items.whenToUse: Segmenting related actions such as previous/next. For selecting among options use toggle-group.
usage:
<%= ui_button_group do %>
  <%= ui_button(variant: :outline) { "Prev" } %>
  <%= ui_button_group_separator %>
  <%= ui_button(variant: :outline) { "Next" } %>
<% end %>

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field layout with label, description, and error message.
items.whenToUse: The standard wrapper for every form control — never lay out form rows with bare divs. Group related fields with ui_field_group, and related checkboxes or radios with ui_field_set plus ui_field_legend.
usage:
<%= ui_field do %>
  <%= ui_field_label(for: "email") { "Email" } %>
  <%= ui_input(type: :email, id: "email", name: "email") %>
  <%= ui_field_description { "We never share it." } %>
  <%= ui_field_error { "Enter a valid email." } %>
<% end %>

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The browser's native select element, styled to match.
items.whenToUse: When you want native mobile pickers and no JavaScript. For a styled listbox use select; for search use combobox.
usage:
<%= ui_native_select(name: "role") do %>
  <option value="admin">Admin</option>
<% end %>

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single region that expands and collapses.
items.whenToUse: One show/hide region. For several coordinated sections use accordion.
usage:
<%= ui_collapsible do %>
  <%= ui_collapsible_trigger { ui_button(variant: :ghost) { "Toggle" } } %>
  <%= ui_collapsible_content { "Hidden content" } %>
<% end %>

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that stays pressed.
items.whenToUse: A single on/off control in a toolbar, such as bold. For several related toggles use toggle-group; for a settings switch use switch.
usage: <%= ui_toggle(pressed: true, "aria-label": "Bold") { ui_icon("bold") } %>

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggle buttons acting as one control.
items.whenToUse: Choosing between two to seven options in a compact toolbar. For form semantics use radio-group; for actions use button-group.
usage:
<%= ui_toggle_group(type: :single) do %>
  <%= ui_toggle_group_item(value: "left") { ui_icon("align-left") } %>
  <%= ui_toggle_group_item(value: "center") { ui_icon("align-center") } %>
<% end %>

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Selects a numeric value from a range by dragging.
items.whenToUse: Imprecise numeric input such as volume or price. For an exact number use input with type: :number.
usage: <%= ui_slider(name: "volume", min: 0, max: 100, value: 50) %>

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A rich preview card shown on hover.
items.whenToUse: Previewing linked content, such as a user profile. For a short hint use tooltip; for click-triggered content use popover.
usage:
<%= ui_hover_card do %>
  <%= ui_hover_card_trigger { link_to "@ada", "#" } %>
  <%= ui_hover_card_content { "Ada Lovelace — mathematician" } %>
<% end %>

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A segmented field for one-time passcodes.
items.whenToUse: Verification codes split into boxes. For ordinary text use input.
usage:
<%= ui_input_otp(name: "code") do %>
  <%= ui_input_otp_group do %>
    <%= ui_input_otp_slot(index: 0) %>
    <%= ui_input_otp_slot(index: 1) %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen.
items.whenToUse: Mobile-friendly overlays anchored to the bottom edge. For a side panel use sheet; for a centred modal use dialog.
usage:
<%= ui_drawer do %>
  <%= ui_drawer_trigger { ui_button(variant: :outline) { "Open" } } %>
  <%= ui_drawer_content do %>
    <%= ui_drawer_header { ui_drawer_title { "Filters" } } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu opened by right-clicking a region.
items.whenToUse: Right-click actions on an element. For a button-triggered menu use dropdown-menu.
usage:
<%= ui_context_menu do %>
  <%= ui_context_menu_trigger { "Right-click here" } %>
  <%= ui_context_menu_content do %>
    <%= ui_context_menu_item { "Copy" } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A horizontal application menu bar.
items.whenToUse: Desktop-style application menus such as File and Edit. For a single button menu use dropdown-menu; for site navigation use navigation-menu.
usage:
<%= ui_menubar do %>
  <%= ui_menubar_menu do %>
    <%= ui_menubar_trigger { "File" } %>
    <%= ui_menubar_content { ui_menubar_item { "New" } } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with optional rich dropdown panels.
items.whenToUse: Primary site navigation in a header. For application menus use menubar; for showing location use breadcrumb.
usage:
<%= ui_navigation_menu do %>
  <%= ui_navigation_menu_list do %>
    <%= ui_navigation_menu_item do %>
      <%= ui_navigation_menu_trigger { "Products" } %>
      <%= ui_navigation_menu_content { ui_navigation_menu_link(href: "/a") { "Analytics" } } %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable, keyboard-driven list of commands.
items.whenToUse: Command palettes and searchable pickers. Put it inside dialog for a ⌘K palette; combine with popover for a combobox.
usage:
<%= ui_command do %>
  <%= ui_command_input(placeholder: "Type a command…") %>
  <%= ui_command_list do %>
    <%= ui_command_empty { "No results." } %>
    <%= ui_command_group(heading: "Suggestions") { ui_command_item { "Calendar" } } %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for selecting a date or a date range.
items.whenToUse: Showing an inline month view, for a single date or a range. For a date field that opens the grid in a popover use date-picker.
usage:
<%# Inline it draws no frame of its own — a popover would. Add one here. %>
<%= ui_calendar(name: "starts_on", selected: Date.current, class: "border") %>

<%# Range: two hidden inputs, two months side by side. %>
<%= ui_calendar(
      mode: :range,
      selected: Date.current..(Date.current + 7),
      number_of_months: 2,
      name: "trip[starts_on]",
      end_name: "trip[ends_on]"
    ) %>

<%# Month and year selects instead of a label. min:/max: disable the days
    outside the range and bound the year select. %>
<%= ui_calendar(name: "born_on", caption_layout: :dropdown, max: Date.current) %>

<%# Mirrored grid and localized labels. %>
<%= ui_calendar(
      name: "date",
      dir: :rtl,
      month_names: I18n.t("date.month_names").compact,
      day_names: I18n.t("date.abbr_day_names")
    ) %>

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels the user can resize by dragging a handle.
items.whenToUse: Split layouts with user-adjustable panes, such as a list and detail view.
usage:
<%= ui_resizable_panel_group(direction: :horizontal) do %>
  <%= ui_resizable_panel { "List" } %>
  <%= ui_resizable_handle %>
  <%= ui_resizable_panel { "Detail" } %>
<% end %>

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A horizontally or vertically swipeable set of slides.
items.whenToUse: Browsing images or cards one at a time. For a scrollable region without slide semantics use scroll-area.
usage:
<%= ui_carousel do %>
  <%= ui_carousel_content do %>
    <%= ui_carousel_item { "Slide 1" } %>
    <%= ui_carousel_item { "Slide 2" } %>
  <% end %>
  <%= ui_carousel_previous %>
  <%= ui_carousel_next %>
<% end %>

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable single-select built from popover, command, and button.
items.whenToUse: Choosing one option from a long list where typing to filter matters. For short lists use select; for the native control use native-select. This item installs its parts rather than a Ui::ComboboxComponent — compose them yourself.
usage:
<%= ui_popover do %>
  <%= ui_popover_trigger { ui_button(variant: :outline) { "Select framework…" } } %>
  <%= ui_popover_content do %>
    <%= ui_command do %>
      <%= ui_command_input(placeholder: "Search…") %>
      <%= ui_command_list { ui_command_item { "Rails" } } %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date field that opens a calendar in a popover.
items.whenToUse: Picking a date in a form: as a button, as a typed text field, as a range, or as a date of birth. For an always-visible month grid use calendar. There is no Ui::DatePickerComponent — this item installs the parts plus the ui-date-picker controller that keeps the field and the calendar in step, and you compose them.
usage:
<%# Basic. The calendar owns the value; ui-date-picker only writes the picked date into the label and closes the popover. %>
<%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(variant: :outline, class: "w-[212px] justify-between font-normal") do %> Pick a date <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", class: "opacity-50") %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "due_on") %> <% end %> <% end %>

<%# Labelled. The trigger is a plain button, so id:/for: tie it to the label. %>
<%= ui_field(class: "w-48", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %>
  <%= ui_field_label(for: "checkin") { "Date" } %>
  <%# ...the same Popover, with ui_popover_trigger(id: "checkin", ...) %>
<% end %>

<%# Range. Same shell, range calendar: name: is the start, end_name: the end.
    The popover closes on the second pick, not the first. %>
<%= ui_calendar(
      mode: :range,
      selected: Date.current..(Date.current + 20),
      number_of_months: 2,
      name: "stay[from]",
      end_name: "stay[to]"
    ) %>

<%# Date of birth. Month/year selects for the decade-long jump, and max:
    keeps the future out — it bounds the year select too. %>
<%= ui_calendar(name: "profile[born_on]", caption_layout: :dropdown, max: Date.current) %>

<%# Text input. What is typed is parsed into the calendar, what is picked comes
    back formatted. Down arrow opens the popover. %>
<%= ui_field(class: "w-60", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %>
  <%= ui_field_label(for: "subscribed-on") { "Subscription date" } %>
  <%= ui_input_group do %>
    <%= ui_input_group_input(id: "subscribed-on", autocomplete: "off",
          data: { ui_date_picker_target: "input" }) %>
    <%= ui_input_group_addon(align: :inline_end) do %>
      <%# Popover + Calendar, triggered by
          ui_popover_trigger(variant: :ghost, size: :icon, class: "size-6! rounded-sm") %>
    <% end %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

<%# Date and time. The picker owns the day; a native time input owns the clock. %>
<%= ui_input(type: :time, name: "meeting[at]", step: 1, value: "10:30:00",
      class: "appearance-none bg-background [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:hidden") %>

<%# Natural language. Accepts "today", "in 2 weeks", "next friday". The phrase table is in ui_date_picker_controller.js — extend it for your locale. %> <%= ui_field(data: { controller: "ui-date-picker", ui_date_picker_natural_language_value: "true" }) do %> <%# ...input-group as above, plus an echo of the parsed date: %> <%= ui_field_description do %> Publishing on . <% end %> <% end %>

<%# RTL. dir: :rtl mirrors the grid, the nav arrows and the ← → keys. %>
<%= ui_calendar(
      name: "date",
      dir: :rtl,
      month_names: I18n.t("date.month_names").compact,
      day_names: I18n.t("date.abbr_day_names")
    ) %>

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Transient toast notifications.
items.whenToUse: Brief confirmations that do not need acknowledgement. For messages that stay on the page use alert; for ones requiring a decision use alert-dialog.
usage: <%= ui_sonner %>

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Chart.js charts using the Shadwire theme tokens.
items.whenToUse: Visualising series data. Pins chart.js via importmap and needs Stimulus. For plain tabular numbers use table.
usage: <%= ui_chart(type: :bar, data: { labels: %w[Jan Feb], datasets: [{ label: "Sales", data: [12, 19] }] }) %>

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A table with sorting, filtering, pagination, and row selection.
items.whenToUse: Tabular data that needs interaction out of the box. When you only need markup and styling use table.
usage: <%= ui_data_table(columns: [{ key: :name, label: "Name" }], rows: @users.map { |u| { name: u.name } }, filter_key: :name) %>
